description.value: Threefold is a brewery collective that brings together three craft breweries — Temporal Artisanal Ales, Boombox, and Slow Hand — under one roof on Powell Street in East Vancouver. The tasting lounge pairs rotating craft beers on tap with a full Neapolitan-style pizza menu plus snacks and desserts. It offers a relaxed, food-forward taproom experience with a strong selection of vegetarian and vegan options.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Threefold is a real, active brewery collective with a food menu and takeout ordering, located at 1507 Powell Street, Vancouver — the OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but Powell Street is in East Vancouver, a discrepancy worth flagging. Takeout is confirmed by 'Order Takeout' and 'To-Go List' navigation links on the website. The food menu explicitly labels items with (vg) for vegetarian, (v) for vegan, and (g/f) for gluten-free, confirming dietary options.
